[package]
name = "hornscribe-desktop"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "HornScribe desktop shell (UI-001 spike)"
authors = ["HornScribe project"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77.2"

# Desktop-only spike: the Tauri 2 template ships ["staticlib", "cdylib", "rlib"]
# for mobile embedding, but on x86_64-pc-windows-gnu the cdylib link fails —
# GNU ld auto-exports every symbol (~89,700 > the 65,535 DLL export limit).
# rlib alone is sufficient for the bin target; revisit if mobile is added.
[lib]
name = "hornscribe_desktop_lib"
crate-type = ["rlib"]

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = [] }
# UI-020 import flow: the native open-file dialog is the only plugin we
# grant — capability-scoped to `dialog:allow-open` (no message/save/ask
# variants, and still no fs/asset-protocol grants). Audio bytes reach the
# webview through the self-limited `read_audio_bytes` command instead.
tauri-plugin-dialog = "2"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
# #230: streaming SHA-256 in audio_probe (already in the lockfile via
# transitive deps — no new downloads).
sha2 = "0.10"
# FEAT-001 (#60): PC再生音源(ループバック)とマイク録音。WebView2 では
# getDisplayMedia が使えないため、WASAPI を直接叩く app-defined commands
# で実装する。`windows` crate は Tauri 経由で既に lock されている
# (0.61.3) ため追加パッケージは増やさない。Win32_Media_Audio /
# SystemCom / Devices_Enum を有効化する。
windows = { version = "0.61", features = [
  "Win32_Foundation",
  "Win32_Media_Audio",
  "Win32_System_Com",
  "Win32_System_Com_StructuredStorage",
  "Win32_System_Variant",
  "Win32_Devices_Properties",
  "Win32_Devices_FunctionDiscovery",
  "Win32_UI_Shell_PropertiesSystem",
] }

[profile.release]
# Spike defaults: keep symbols for profiling startup/memory.
# Strip/panic=abort/LTO decisions belong to the packaging milestone.
panic = "unwind"
incremental = false
